card.name: Just before a number or product calculation
card.fires_on: Spaces, small linking words and digits in math-style text where a numeric value or multiplication is about to appear, such as before a decimal, exponent or fraction.

modes.label: Before a number
modes.description: A space or digit right before the next digits of a number in a list or fraction.

modes.label: Linking word in multiplication or estimate
modes.description: A small word like by, to or are leading into a calculation or count.

modes.label: Operator or function
modes.description: An equals sign or the word of before a mathematical expression.

card.writes: It promotes product-related tokens (prod, product) and suppresses sum tokens, which suggests the text will go on to a product rather than a sum.
card.plain: It fires in math passages just before a number or multiplication, nudging the model toward the word product instead of sum.
